visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a navy blue baseball jersey with 'Brothers' in gold lettering, a matching cap, and colorful sunglasses is positioned in a baseball dugout. He looks directly at the camera, smiling and talking. Behind him, the dugout wall is covered with sponsor banners, including 'World Gym'. In the bottom left corner, a small inset video shows two figures in baseball uniforms engaging in a rhythmic hand-clapping game. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman with dark hair tied back, also wearing a navy 'Brothers' shirt. She stands in the same dugout environment, holding a translucent green water bottle in her right hand. She speaks expressively to the camera, using her left hand to gesture. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 莎菈教練就是教我這個小遊戲. (2) [Subtitle]: 說簡單也簡單 但是也蠻難的. (3) [Subtitle]: 也是有一個節奏在. (4) [Subtitle]: 有時候在場上伸展完回到球員休息室會有一小段時間. (5) [Subtitle]: 這種時間大部分就是會跟球員小聊一下天. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以找個小遊戲來玩 感覺會蠻有趣的. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個小遊戲其實跟棒球沒有太大的關係. (8) [Subtitle]: 主要只是拉進彼此的距離. (9) [Subtitle]: 對於教練來說取得選手的信任非常重要. (10) [Subtitle]: 尤其對我來講 又是到一個陌生的國家. (11) [Subtitle]: 也讓球員知道我是非常在乎每個球員的. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以有時候這種有趣的小地方. (13) [Subtitle]: 可以跟球員們一起製造歡樂. (14) [Subtitle]: 這件事情其實是非常重要的.
